decisions.reason: The authentication and identity delegation service sits close to the firm's core GIS integration know-how and gained its own page in 2024, so the firm can interpret its results and keep developing it.

The open GIS application development framework is a product line drawing directly on the firm's platform expertise and its standards and research involvement, which gives strong absorptive capacity to keep improving it, although its website visibility has stayed modest.

The identity service for GIS applications was promoted with launch messaging and given its own page, and it fits the firm's integration competence and its strategy of linking GIS with enterprise systems.

The geodata business process consulting workshop uses the firm's decades of consulting and training experience, costs little to run, and supports its other offerings, so there is little reason to drop it soon after launch.
